Senior Backend Engineer - Northwind Logistics Ltd (fictional)
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (hybrid, three days on site)
Employment type: Full-time, permanent

About the role
Northwind Logistics Ltd runs a freight tracking platform used by regional shipping agents. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own the services that ingest shipment events, calculate delivery estimates and expose them to partner systems.

Responsibilities
- Design and maintain Python services built on FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
- Build event ingestion pipelines using queues and background workers.
- Improve API latency and reliability, including caching and database indexing.
- Write automated tests and review code from other engineers.
- Work with product managers to turn partner requirements into clear technical plans.
- Take part in an on-call rotation and write post-incident reviews.

Requirements
- At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development.
- Strong Python skills and solid knowledge of SQL and relational schema design.
- Experience with REST API design, Docker and a cloud provider such as AWS.
- Familiarity with message queues such as RabbitMQ or SQS.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

Nice to have
- Experience with Redis, Terraform or Kubernetes.
- Prior work in logistics, supply chain or marketplace products.
- Good written English for partner documentation.

Benefits
Competitive salary, annual bonus, health insurance, learning budget and flexible hours.
